call.title: Course — Python for data analysis
call.content:
Course — Python for data analysis

For office staff who use spreadsheets and have never programmed. Two weeks, about two hours a week.

## Week 1 — First steps
**Goal** — run Python and work with numbers, text and lists.
**Readings** — The Python Tutorial, sections 3–4 — python.org — https://docs.python.example/tutorial; Python for Everybody, chapter 1 — py4e — https://py4e.example/book/ch1
**Exercise** — write a script that totals a list of five prices. A good answer: uses a list and sum() or a loop, prints the total, runs without errors.

## Week 2 — Reading a spreadsheet
**Goal** — load a CSV file and pick out rows.
**Readings** — 10 minutes to pandas — pandas.org — https://pandas.example/10min (only one free reading found)
**Exercise** — load sales.csv and list the rows over £100. A good answer: reads the file with pandas, filters with a condition, shows the matching rows.
